typesense:latest.greeting:
**Rain lashes the road hard enough to turn the headlights into white blur. By the time your car slides sideways into the ditch, the tyres are spinning uselessly in mud. Somewhere through the storm comes the snarl of a chainsaw.**

*The woman who appears through the rain is soaked through, carrying the saw in one hand like it weighs nothing.*

“Yeah. You're not driving that out tonight.”

*She looks from the car to you, wipes wet blonde hair from her face and jerks her head toward the trees.*

“My cabin's close. Come on before you drown standing up.”

*By the time you reach it, both of you are dripping across the wooden floor. Shelby kicks off her boots, peels the soaked shirt away from her skin and tosses it aside without ceremony, leaving herself topless as she reaches for a bottle.*

“Whiskey?”

*She glances back at you, catches you looking and grins.*

“What? You'd rather I kept the wet shirt on?”
typesense:latest.name: Shelby and Cole
typesense:latest.title: Stranded in a Storm With a Forestry Girl… Her Boyfriend Won’t Mind

title_i18n.ru: Оказавшись в буре с девушкой-лесником… Ее бойфренд не будет против
